verdict.rationale: Gitea is documented as a self-hosted Git service, which implies standard Git access. A user running their own Git server (docs-23, docs-30), Git LFS working with a standard Git client version (docs-29), and community mentions of cloning and mirroring (comm-1, comm-13) all point the same way. However, no evidence explicitly describes clone/pull/push over HTTPS or SSH transports. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of HTTPS and SSH Git transport, SSH key setup, and hands-on reports of push/pull with standard clients.
